comments.author: Claudia
comments.body: Best place I've found seems to be the large dead tree at south america northest coast. That's the landing just south of the amazon river mouth. R10 collection FA 1&2 loaded gives me 180 - 200 bark for 650 vigour points. Second best, large dead tree in SE veracruz outskirts. Generally, when collecting this, apply common sense and look for it near a tree rather than a rock.
